transcript: M: Lucy, the print shop needs the final brochure by tomorrow morning. Could we go through it together this afternoon?
W: I'd like to, but I've got a dentist appointment at three.
M: Then how about straight after lunch? It shouldn't take more than half an hour.
W: That works. And we can skip the back page. Tom went over it yesterday.
M: The page with all the prices? Oh, good. That'll save us some time.
W: So we only need to check the photos and headings. I'll bring a printed copy so we can mark changes by hand.
M: Great. I'll book a meeting room for one o'clock, then.

questions.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "I've got a dentist appointment at three"?

options.A: She cannot work on the brochure today
options.B: She thinks the deadline should be extended
options.C: She would prefer to meet tomorrow morning
options.D: She will not be free later in the afternoon

options.A: Taken the photos for the brochure
options.D: Printed a copy of the brochure

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?

options.A: Reserve a room for their meeting
